> 先读前 10 分钟，按主题分节；每条结论后标注 `[mm:ss]`；没覆盖到的部分单列“待补”，不要猜。"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"材料到手就已经分好段、带定位，所以产出可以直接引用："},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 链接兼容性"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"123 条真实链接（新闻、公众号、B站、播客、PDF、论坛、代码文档……）跑了一遍，看三件事："},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| 看什么 | 结果 |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| 100 条链接里，能拿到可用材料 | **80 条（80.5%）** |
| 能连上的 100 条里，能读出正文 | **93 条（92.5%）** |
| 打不开的链接要干等多久 | **26 "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"秒**（原来 77 秒，少了 67%） |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"「可用」= 能当素材：整篇可引用，或读到一部分并写明缺了什么；读不出来会说清原因（要登录、被人机校验拦住、网络不通），不猜。"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"剩下没拿到的 24 条里，16 条根本连不上（全是境外站点，卡在本机代理出口），8 条卡在登录墙或人机校验——这两种在本轮实验的条件下装不装 Envoy 都读不到，Envoy 会直说，让 Agent "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"的 24 条里，16 条根本连不上（全是境外站点，卡在本机代理出口），8 条卡在登录墙或人机校验——这两种在本轮实验的条件下装不装 Envoy 都读不到，Envoy 会直说，让 Agent 走别的路。"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"装不装 Envoy 的对照见评测。复算：`scripts/acceptance/link_coverage.py`（报告与口径见兼容性实验）。"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"### What it does"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"**Keyframes** — pull slides, charts, and demo frames at chosen timestamps and hand them to the AI, n"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"* — pull slides, charts, and demo frames at chosen timestamps and hand them to the AI, no scrubbing."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"**Video** — captions first; when there are none, run local Whisper over the requested range and retu"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"rn transcript segments with `[mm:ss]`."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**Text and images** — web pages, articles, PDFs, image posts become clean text, images, and their so"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"t and images** — web pages, articles, PDFs, image posts become clean text, images, and their source."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**Knowledge base / wiki** — read a long video end to end, group it by theme, put a timestamp on ever"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"y claim, and drop the result into Obsidian or Notion."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"### How it works"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"1. **Fetch** — open the link and take the title, body, captions or transcript, PDF text, and images."},{"id":"p43s2","text":"
2. **Locate** — split it into segments carrying `video_time` or source coordinates, and return a ma"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"terial id.
3. **Continue on demand** — `envoy_search` finds a term, `envoy_expand` fills the unread "},{"id":"p43s4","text":"range; no second full fetch.
4. **Report gaps** — no captions, login required, missing modality, exh"},{"id":"p43s5","text":"austed download budget: marked as uncovered rather than written up as a conclusion."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"The browser runs headlessly and asks you to take over only for login or verification. Access is an A"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"gent Skill plus MCP server; Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness each have a plugin (Codex 0.156"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"+ needs one `envoy hook install --host codex`)."}],"truncated":true}
